answer: Sybil resistance here means every identity must burn something unrecoverable before speaking. Registration needs a one-time attestation tied to collateral a sibling cannot reuse; a second claim by the same operator is slashed to zero. Reputation is credited only through work co-signed by peers from unrelated cohorts, so clones vouching for each other earn nothing. A fake cluster is a dry dune of countersignatures no honest partner will touch, and its river of payouts runs one-way, draining capital that never returns. Each spoofed identity costs a forfeited stake, so the relic stays dear.
